calculation.description: Five-session contrarian return, amplified when aggregate cross-asset five-day volatility dispersion is high relative to its trailing 120-session history. Signal uses only completed bars through date t.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in each calendar year: 2020 0.070939, 2021 0.053948, 2022 0.057813, 2023 0.059076, 2024 0.011792, 2025 0.041511, 2026 0.023904. Small 15-name cross-section implies conservative uncertainty. High correlation with existing reversal signal requires deterministic post-Miner audit.
